notes.content:

notes.title: Update: Ver 2.012
notes.content:
Update v2.012 for the full version had been deployed. This is to fix the problem where the game doesn't start unless Offline mode is selected. In tandem with this fix, the Offline mode option had been removed as well.

Thank you for understanding, and have fun!

notes.title: Regarding Ver 2.011
notes.content:
Due to an incompatibility with the system, playing the game with the online features (online leaderboards, replay download) via the Steam launcher is unavailable. The game can still be played via the Steam launcher in Offline mode.

However, the online functions are still available if you play the game via the local files. Until we can resolve the issue, please access the game via the local files to enjoy its full features.

Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Hell Blasters Version 2.0 is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41002584/6ea7ca279073e214c5a46deb695109145ca1b03b.jpg[/img]
[b]WELCOME TO LOOP 2.0![/b]

Major update Ver 2.0 is here!

[list]
[*]New Mean Difficulty! There is very little room for error. Please be careful!
[*]Arrange Mode is added! The better you play the harder it gets! Can you persevere under the pressure?
[*]New Arranged Tracks done by crisp, Jasson Prestiliano (JP Soundworks) and Scowsh! You can adjust which arrangement to use on which mode via the Options menu.
[*]New languages added: Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese!
[*]2 new wallpapers are added!
[*]8 new endings are added! The new endings are for Arcade Mean and Arrange Mode.
[*]8 new Achievements are added!
[*]Several bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: v1.017
notes.content:
Update v1.017 for the full version and update v1.027 for the demo version had been deployed. This is to fix the problem where the replay doesn't record the held button while quick-restarting the game.

This update won't automatically fix affected replay files. However, the files can still be fixed manually. If you have any that you want to be fixed, please tell us the button you remember had been pressing when quick-restarting and send the affected replay file within %localappdata%/HellBlasters for the full version and %localappdata%/HellBlastersDemo for the demo version to us, ideally via email ( admin@playshift-games.com ). The replays uploaded online can also be fixed by also reporting the ranking position of the affected replay file by the time of the report.

Thank you for understanding, and have fun!

notes.title: Update: v1.014
notes.content:
Update v1.014 for the full game and v1.024 for the demo has been updated.

Thank you for understanding, and have fun!

notes.title: Demo Update: v1.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41002584/36cca021b9bf611845701094694d5d5bc1c849aa.jpg[/img]
The demo has been updated to v1.02 to fix some critical bugs and adding some quality of life improvements. The fix also applies for the upcoming full version, v1.01.
[list]
[*]Leaderboard has been reset. Now the leaderboards will record more than 10 digits of score. On the Steam leaderboard menu the numbers shown will be far smaller than the ones shown in-game.
[*]Option to show FPS and to toggle V-Sync have been added.
[*]Several bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your attention, and have fun!

notes.title: Leaderboards will be Reset on October 6th 2021 00:00 PDT
notes.content:
On October 6th 2021 00:00 PDT the full version will be updated to v1.01 and the demo version will be updated to v1.02. One of the main updates is to truncate the registered scores into the Steam leaderboards system by 5 digits. The actual scores will be shown like normal within the in-game Ranking menu. Replays from previous versions will still be fully compatible.

However, due to this reason new high scores will not be registered because it will be lower than the ones already registered on Steam leaderboards. To address this, on October 6th 2021 00:00 PDT the leaderboards will be reset, deleting the posted scores and the attached replay files.

It is suggested to download the replays from the online leaderboards if there are any replays you wish to keep before it's reset.

Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Demo Update: v1.01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41002584/9462e25b3bed8c09273acdbee347e7f45f5e5daa.jpg[/img]
The demo has been updated to v1.01 to fix some critical bugs and adding some quality of life improvements. The fix also applies for the upcoming full version.
[list]
[*]Quick restart had been added. By press and holding the assigned Pause button you can immediately restart the run. it functions the same as the Restart function in the Pause menu.
[*]WASD keys can now be configured. Please note that with this update the only keyboard buttons that will be affected by the Link Rotation option are the arrow keys.
[*]Replays of runs using arrow keys now will be recorded properly. Previously affected save files cannot be fixed.
[*]The score entry screen now can be fast forwarded by pressing the accept button.
[*]Several minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your attention, and have fun!
